import sys

def f(n):
    Len = 400000
    pi_upper = [0] * Len
    pi_lower = [0] * Len
    for i in range(1, Len):
        pi_lower[i] = i
        pi_upper[i] = n // i
    is_prime = [True] * Len
    is_prime[0] = False
    is_prime[1] = False
    prime_list = []
    for i in range(2, Len):
        if not is_prime[i]:
            continue
        prime_list.append(i)
        for j in range(i * 2, Len, i):
            is_prime[j] = False
    for t, p in enumerate(prime_list):
        i = 1
        while i < Len and n // i >= p * p:
            if p * i < Len:
                val = pi_upper[p * i]
            else:
                val = pi_lower[n // i // p]
            pi_upper[i] -= (val - (t + 1))
            i += 1
        for i in range(Len - 1, p * p - 1, -1):
            pi_lower[i] -= (pi_lower[i // p] - (t + 1))
    ans = 0
    for p in prime_list:
        if p * p > n:
            break
        if p * p * p <= n and p * p * p > 0:
            ans += 1
        if n // p > p:
            if p < Len:
                ans += pi_upper[p] - pi_lower[p]
            else:
                ans += pi_lower[n // p] - pi_lower[p]
    return ans

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    print(f(n))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
